name: incremental-content
body: Feature incremental-content (win B, the core of the project). On a changed tree, `apg scan` must reuse per-file scanner facts and run each language frontend only over the affected target set, while producing a graph that is exactly equivalent to a full scan. Tier 2 — exact-ongoing; no heuristic pass and no provenance/confidence tier. This capability covers the content-addressed manifest, cross-worktree cache sharing, the delta + fallback rules, the impact-set closure with signature early-cutoff, the full-context/targeted-emission frontend contract, and cache invalidation by resolution inputs and global keys.
